Cat Cafe Quest · gameplay pass 2

A little more adventure.
A lot more to come back to.

Read a household boss. Find the missing set piece. Build for burst, comfort or curiosity. Keep a journal of the cafe you have made your own.

Candidate build (branch ai/codex-gameplay-2-2026-11-05 stack, runtime sha 629aa8b3dd0120f1a3e9556b699d539155202296), not live. No merge, deployment, wallet, server writes or tradable rewards.

A choice within reach

Eight different encounters. A safe Gather if you step away. New local opportunities every sixteen seconds.

A kit with a purpose

Three sets, four affixes and two saved outfits. Match 2/3/4 pieces; compare damage and effective HP.

A home that remembers

Mastery, collections and optional tours. Honest capped return patches; no deadlines or streak loss.

Playable · actual candidate component and rules

The evening patrol

Choose a review fixture, then use Patrol / Wardrobe / Workshop / Journal / Cafe. The fixture buttons are review shortcuts; the normal game starts with the fresh kit. Keyboard: 1 Dodge, 2 Break, 3 Interrupt, P Pounce.

Measured pacing · three distinct seeds

More chances to choose.

The main loop changes from 30s to 18s claims. The opt-in Sample adds route choices and boss counter windows. Lines show observed moments, not a claim that every moment was a meaningful human decision.

Inside the candidate

Real build captures. Full 1280×720, 1440×900 and 1920×1080 evidence lives in the ledger; these embedded views work without a network.

Every number has a home.

All new gameplay tunables live in config.ts. Existing first reward remains 10s. Relic limits, market scope and authoritative replay are unchanged. “Absent” means a new default-off Sample rule.

Small pixels, original stories.

16 original procedural assets, 3,268 runtime bytes. Python3, locked palette, upper-left light. Exact prompt: none. No model, external art inputs, tracing or copied game art. Reproduce with python3 -B tools/art/gameplay2.py; verify with --check. Full geometry and hashes: tools/art/gameplay2-manifest.json and reports/gameplay2/asset-provenance.md.

Fresh guest with onboarding: http://127.0.0.1:5391/?demo#home
Skip coach: http://127.0.0.1:5391/?demo&coach=off#home
Sample adventure: http://127.0.0.1:5391/?demo&coach=off&adventure=1#home
Development review controls: add &adventureDebug=1. Jump rooms, grant local patches/kit, or advance 60s. Select a room then Challenge boss. Controls are absent from production.

Depth is currently a local Sample. No new system grants server Fish, Yarn, Cat Keys or Relics. This is one author's scripted evidence and self-review, not a human playtest or proof of retention. Review and recheck the full draft stack before any release decision.

Candidate build, not live. Designed and implemented in one agent session. No external art inputs.
